segments.text: Color code of web ceiling
You must have seen that web ceiling comes in a lot of colors
So you can ask from interviewers, what is the meaning of these colors?
So if any web ceiling is of violent color
Then you can lift 1 ton load, maximum
Next if any web ceiling is of green color
Then you can lift 2 ton material
If it is yellow then you can lift 3 ton material
If it is gray then you can lift 4 ton material
If it is red then you can lift 5 ton load
If it is brown then you can lift 6 ton load
If it is blue then you can lift 8 ton load
And if it is orange then you can lift 10 to 12 ton
So this is the meaning of color code, you can take its screen shot
